source.section: Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7; line 10b: 65 or older on December 31, 2025

worked: Single, born 1961-01-01: by the tax rule a person reaches an age the day before the birthday, so this filer is 65 on December 31, 2025 and gets the 250 line 10b exemption. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 = 22,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 40,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 40,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 40,000.00. Schedule SB: no subtraction applies; line 50 0.00. Schedule SB line 17: federal AGI 40,000.00 is not less than 15,000.00, so no 5,000 subtraction. Form 1 line 6 0.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 40,000.00 - 0.00 = 40,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 40,000 to less than 40,500, column Single: 11,076.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 40,000 / 40,500 / 11,076 / 22,729 / 6,618 / 12,859). Line 9 = 40,000.00 - 11,076.00 = 28,924.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 1 x 250 = 250.00; line 10c 950.00. Line 11 taxable income = 28,924.00 - 950.00 = 27,974.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 13,294.00 = 584.936; total 1,098.736, rounded once to 1,098.74. The Tax Table row 27,900 to 28,000 (PDF page 39) gives 1,098; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,098.74.
